title: Announcement [COMPLETE] COUNTDOWN TO CHRISTMAS - 2024 RMW Advent Spotlight

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
Day #1
​
Can you believe it’s already that time of year again?!
Before we begin the proceedings on our winter tradition—if you are new to our community or returning to us from a time ago, make sure to check out
2023’s Advent Spotlight
.
It is my greatest wish that you will visit the threads of these immensely generous contributors and continue to give thanks for their hard work, past and present.
The most important rule of Advent
is to spread cheer!
Avery
Don’t get yourself too down if winter is not quite your thing!
@Avery
has started advent off with a selection of food icons. Hotdogs and ice creams speak back to summertime, so we’re easing into the thought of December. We also have been gifted a gorgeous angel battler in a wide selection of color options. Don’t forget the matching spites that already exist!
Slimmmeiske2
It’s a wonderful idea to start a project with what we love most, and
@slimmmeiske2
has kicked things off with a set of fire-element fairies. This is continuing a long-running series of fairy sprites in her catalogue. These come in multiple color ways to really diversify the look and feel of environments needing the warmth and magic of fire.
GalacticGod
@GalacticGod
really understands what everyone wants for Christmas…giant robots. C’mon. You know you’ve always wanted one! This SV Battler of MZ - SF_SlaughterRobot is definitely meant to impress and make the climatic battle of your sci-fi adventure truly complete.
hiddenone
@hiddenone
is starting us out with a type of resource I personally cannot get enough up,
window skins!!
Truly, such an easy way to change up the look of your game. I collect these like candy canes to hang on the tree. We’ve been given three different options
in addition to white
, striking the most primary of color ways among us. You decide what color really speaks the spirit of your game!
StarbirdResources
Always, always
@Starbird_Resources
is offering creative and fully realized show stopping pieces that can really define the character of a location. Advent is starting strong with a set of tiles perfect to create an orc encampment. These orcs definitely have a creative architecture that I think that makes for a memorable game location!
WaywardMartian
@WaywardMartian
returns once again with more additions to, honestly, probably the largest selection of sprite bases and sprite parts I can recall. If you fancy a DYI, check out the entire thread! Advent is going to be spent clothing their series of dwarf bases. Which…is great because it’s getting so cold outside! We’re starting with some tops, so in advent tradition we are eagerly awaiting pants.
Guardinthena
The way to my heart. SPACE.
@Guardinthena
is starting us out with, if I may say so, the most perfect astronaut sprite. Down sprite included! An essential pickup for any number of sci-fi games. We could always use the quick trip to space, right?
Thank you, all~

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
Day #2
​
You know the drill! Leave your likes, comments, and love in our contributor’s threads by opening the links to reveal your gifts for the day!
Avery
Even more sweet, frozen treats from
@Avery
today! Everyone can find an icon for their favorite flavors! We’ve also been gifted a special set of signage that is absolutely
perfect
for decorating and improving the functional navigation of your city and town maps! Many options exist to really create an individuality to the establishments you’ll journey to. Not enough? Blank signs are primed and ready for your DIY skills!
Slimmmeiske2
Serving. High Fashion.
@slimmmeiske2
has taken an avant-garde look into the future when imagining this sprite set of sci-fi women. Structural hair cuts, bold fashion colors, statement eyewear, and metallic elements are on trend this season.
GalacticGod
Wowzers! What a set! Anyone traveling this holiday season will be all too familiar with the sights of
@GalacticGod
‘s airport tileset. Included is a single aisle twin jet, ATC tower, and a full set of ground crew equipment that will surely do double duty for any construction or factory settings! Don’t forget your clearances to tower after takeoff!!
Starbird_Resources
Continuing the tileset for the orc encampment
@Starbird_Resources
shows they are about more than brute strength! We now have tilesets that show off their mastery of artwork and textiles. The building looks like a perfect center of town, perhaps a cultural center or even the leader’s quarters?
WaywardMartian
Looks like we’re settling in for a few more days of public indecency while
@WaywardMartian
works on getting the pants together. Today we’re treated to tops for the male dwarf sprites to balance the tops for female dwarf sprites. I suppose it’s only fair that the men get something to match the ladies!
Guardinthena
@Guardinthena
hopped right back in to the mix to make sure the astronaut didn’t have to pilot the galaxies all on their own. We’ve been gifted an android set with sprites, down pose, and face sets in four different color ways. Each with two eye colors! Is the android friend or foe?
Thank you, all~

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
Day #3
​
You know the drill! Leave your likes, comments, and love in our contributor’s threads by opening the links to reveal your gifts for the day!
Avery
A fantastic resource that can double up from
@Avery
!! These posts come in three colors and can be turned into lamp posts and signage posts using the sign sets from Day #2. Your towns will be fabulously decorated, cohesive, and really give off the appearance of having it all together!
Slimmmeiske2
Tapping into another palette of sci-fi,
@slimmmeiske2
comes prepared with another set of sprites for a young man today. Instead of rich jewel tones and subdued tones of metals, we’re really calling into bubble gum, fun, nightlife, and street fashion for a more punk expression of the genre.
GalacticGod
You need a wolf battler right? Everyone needs a wolf battler…right? I feel like
@GalacticGod
’s SV Battler for MZ_Moster_3, the Wolfman, is going to be pretty popular. A
perfect follow up to the battler
made a couple calendars ago~
Starbird_Resources
Oh man. Good gravy. It really isn’t every day that you get a tileset with such intense story telling.
@Starbird_Resources
has made sure these orc’s can fully express themselves through the
ahem
, culinary arts. A fine selection of weapons are also provided. Seriously, go check out the whole set!
WaywardMartian
The lady dwarves are leading the way into the fully clothed category for
@WaywardMartian
’s sprite builder. There is a pant option and a skirt option for any dwarf to achieve their ideal standard of comfort.
Guardinthena
A very thoughtfully made set of face graphics and sprites from
@Guardinthena
This set comes with a portrait and sprite (down pose included) for 4 variants of a monk character. Hopefully this can help you achieve the right look and feel for any spiritual elements in your projects!
Thank you, all~

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
Day #4
​
You know the drill! Leave your likes, comments, and love in our contributor’s threads by opening the links to reveal your gifts for the day!
Avery
This emote set for the Evil Book is perfect for anyone not quite ready to look past the Halloween season.
@Avery
‘s fantastic creation features a progression of expression that gets outwardly dark and spooky. This is a perfect option for a special character sequence or a boss encounter.
Slimmmeiskie2
The sprite offered to us from
@slimmmeiske2
is envisioned as a bride but can easily be the royally dressed as well. No matter what real world or fictional world wedding custom your project features, there is a perfect dress color with and without the veil!
GalacticGod
@GalacticGod
has transformed yet another Thalzon battler and brought it into full, animated life. Plant_22 is now ready for battle! I’d honestly have a hard time beating this cutie up. No worries, maybe he’s a friend instead?!
He’s just a little guy!
Starbird_Resources
On this day,
@Starbird_Resources
has taken a
slight
break from the uh…extracurriculars in this orc village to bring a selection of autotiles. Many of the colors do quite easily call back to the orc village and are a perfect companion to the mapping needs of this village’s complete story arc.
WaywardMartian
We did folks! All risk of public indecency has been mitigated.
@WaywardMartian
has provided several pants and shoe options for the dwarf gents. Now we all get to wait with wonder for all the incredible decorations and accessories that are bound to follow!
Guardinthena
Oooooee. Limestone, wrought iron, a clock face…what is there
not
to love about
@Guardinthena
’s SF_Castle Tiles? This is a stunning set that really captures the mystique and intrigue of something that’s a little old, but a little new about an RPG city.
Thank you, all~

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
Day #5
​
You know the drill! Leave your likes, comments, and love in our contributor’s threads by opening the links to reveal your gifts for the day!
Avery
Creepy dolls anyone?
@Avery
has crafted a set in four different color schemes and those dresses are perfect for that classic, creepy Victorian doll. Avery makes the suggestion of each doll signifying a different level of possession, which is a rather fun idea! What ideas would you come up with?
Slimmmeiske2
Feeling the call and pull,
@slimmmeiske2
has opted for those beloved fairies. This sheet of air element fairies comes with a much softer, natural expression of color to embody the breeze. While categorized as air, these tones really are begging to work their way into any spring maps.
GalacticGod
Sinister grin, fluid movement, a dynamic shout and damage recoil…
@GalacticGod
‘s SV Battler for this goblin knight is truly exquisite. Not all goblins are easy to defeat and this one will surely put up a fight!
Starbird_Resources
Y’all think
@Starbird_Resources
might be having a little
too
much fun with these orc tiles? The story being crafted in these tiles is getting outright
chilling.
You better go share your praise so
you
stay off the menu!
WaywardMartian
It is time for our dwarves to grow out their luscious locks of hair.
@WaywardMartian
has gifted us a long hair style with the ends tied off for the ladies, and a shorter shoulder length do with a top knot for the gents.
Guardinthena
Fantastic SV Battlers for a fantastic and interesting MV character.
@Guardinthena
has rounded out some entries from Avery’s MV library, which included the concept of the living form of the MV Monster6. There are so many angles her story could be taken. Go grab Avery’s MV add-ons in addition to Guardinthena’s SV Battlers and give it a shot!
Thank you, all~

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
ADVENT POWER HOUR
Day #6-8
​
Catching up opening this advent calendar!
Ooooooeeeeee.
You know the drill! Leave your likes, comments, and love in our contributor’s threads by opening the links to reveal your gifts for the day!
Avery
Day 6
,
Day 7
,
Day 8
I’m telling you. It wouldn’t quite be an advent without one of
@Avery
‘s to-die-for modular icon sets. These are gifts that keep on giving as it allows you to customize the look and feel of your weapons and other collectibles! This time around we have a bow and arrow set to really make sure your archers are equipped with any weapon options you can dream!
Next we have some weather icons that I am probably unreasonably excited for. These are clearly perfect for anyone implementing a weather system, though the moon and sun are perfect for simple day and night needs. Day #7 is completed with a charming set of angel battlers in several complexions and hair combinations, but keep that folder open and ready for more because Day #8 delivers complimentary sprites!
Slimmmeiske2
Day 6
,
Day 7
,
Day 8
Never-ending cuteness from
@slimmmeiske2
‘s calendar. On day #6 we’ve been given sprites for a chocolatier. This character features adorable space buns and bangs. Her fit features a cap, a waistcoat, and a stripped skirt that I imagine is fluffed up by many petticoats~
Day #7 brings us some selections from Slim’s Halloween Jam game “Pumpkin Decorating” (very quick and very cute play, by the way). The colors and textures in the wall and wooden elements really bring out that autumnal and cabin feel. We also have some of the sprite work in addition to some reimagining of the MZ’s cast clothing. It would be really interesting to see and imagine them outside of their rolls as combat characters!
Day #8 brings us more beloved fairies. This is Kasey and friends in a lovely assortment of punchy tertiary colors for whimsical wing designs.
GalacticGod
Day 6
,
Day 7
,
Day 8
Everyone loves a complete set! The goblin knight from Day #5 has swiftly been accompanied by a sprite on #6. This really opens up the opportunity to make a significant and/or reoccurring presence with this character!
Day #7 brings MZ_People2_1 to battler form, really proving that anyone can be ready for combat with the right imagination and staging! Day #8 brings us what I suspect could be a resource favorite—weapons! We have quite a selection of the RPG classics, though a fiddle has been provided as a truly unique find of the bunch for your bards and other musical characters.
Though, as a fiddle player this hurts my heart a little to imagine smacking someone with my fiddle.
Starbird_Resources
Day 6
,
Day 7
,
Day 8
For Day #6
@Starbird_Resources
keeps us intwined in the gripping tale of this orc story arc. Y’know? Our orcs here really do continue to be quite the artists with these carved emblems, but we’ve once again seen their propensity for violence with the war drums, freakin’
canons,
and another pot big enough to cook us in!!
Day #7 takes us in an alien direction with quite interesting purple flora, trees truly born of the imagination, and sentient (and hungry!!) cliff sides. Though, I gotta say…so many of the orc sets feature this beautiful purple color. It could 100% work. It’s
your
game. Go crazy!
Day #8 really rounds us out with another selection of otherworldly items (tentacle brain hut?!) and additional accessories to the complete tale being woven by the calendar.
WaywardMartian
Day 6
,
Day 7
,
Day 8
@WaywardMartian
has continued to get these dwarfs primped, styled, and ready for battle. Day #6 features what I find to be one of the quintessential dwarven hair accessories, tons of extra braids~ Meant to frame the face, these side braids will fit both sprite bases perfectly! The other
other
required style is found in Day #7. The braided long beard! A must have!
Day #8 starts the gearing out for battle. This set of armor is for the ladies and features a few different color options with beautiful embroidery to accent the textile elements.
Guardinthena
Day 6
,
Day 7
,
Day 8
Day #6 gives us a truly natural and wonderful expansion for MV skeleton battlers. Even more,
@Guardinthena
is truly correct. Sky is the limit here. Dress them up!! While these are good to go in current form, these absolutely serve as templates for any flavor of skeleton needed to terrorize your RPG.
With another wonderful and thoughtful expansion on MV favorites, Day #7 finally lets us inside PanduMaru’s legendary windmill. This can easily be the backdrop to an integral (or even secret!!) moment of the game. Legendary expansions for legendary assets. What a true gift!!
Day #8 takes us somewhere new, somewhere many of us would like to be. A hot spring! A staple in many RPGs, this new auto tile will make it a quick and simple reality.
Thank you, all~

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
Day #9
​
You know the drill! Leave your likes, comments, and love in our contributor’s threads by opening the links to reveal your gifts for the day!
Avery
The angels most certainly do not need to be foes, they can absolutely be friends!
@Avery
has completed a set of busts and portraits that align with each of the angel sprites shared earlier. They can be the perfect companion character or give you the means to create an entire location based on angels!
Slimmmeiske2
Speaking of companion character, I think
@slimmmeiske2
’s “sci-fi” fairies have serious sidekick potential as well. I can definitely see her as the helpful ally that gives our main character the assist throughout a long journey.
GalacticGod
If you didn’t already know it,
@GalacticGod
loves bringing characters from the Marvel Universe to life. For this calendar we’ve been given a sprite and SV Battler for X-Men’s Professor X, as seen in the hovering wheelchair. Make sure to go check out the rest of their work if you’ve been looking for these characters!!
Starbird_Resources
Oooo boy. It’s another spicy meatball of an orc update! There’s a little something for everyone in here.
@Starbird_Resources
has provided quite a fantastic set of columns and doors that really give “special door” vibes. So, let’s just
say
if some rather medieval-lookin capital punishment isn’t quite your thing, there’s still something here for you!
WaywardMartian
The perfect follow up to
@WaywardMartian
‘s armor for the ladies, is…you guessed it! Armor for the gents! This set features the same colors and textiles, so they are ready to go into this fight as one!
Guardinthena
Again! So thoughtful! I think this is a really great idea!
@Guardinthena
has created a set of skeleton icons to accompany all the other skeleton resources made over the course of the calendar. The suggestion to make a quest to collect the bones to revive the dancer character is SO GOOD.
Thank you, all~
​

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
Day #10
​
You know the drill! Leave your likes, comments, and love in our contributor’s threads by opening the links to reveal your gifts for the day!
Avery
Game assets that make me hungry.
@Avery
’s pizza animation and set looks good enough to eat!! An excellent resource to add that special flare to any setting where pizzas may also inhabit. My favorite pizza? Supreme. Just about everything on the pizza.
Ham and pineapple did nothing wrong.
Slimmmeiske2
It’s a royal time in
@slimmmeiske2
‘s calendar. Complimenting a newly crowned king from last year is now a newly crowned queen, making the princess of RTP a queen in her own right…or not. Who said anything about a peaceful succession?! Day 10’s set also comes with many recolors, focusing on black as the central color. Sprites and busts included! There is a set for the RTP characters as we know them, but also a fully recolored pairing as well.
GalacticGod
We have finally returned to
@GalacticGod
’s NPC Character sets! We have a sprite and SV battler for quite a renowned and resourceful butcher. Think about all the effort and trials the inhabitants of your game world may need to experience to bring you, the main character, such delightfully unique and special wares.
Starbird_Resources
Another infusion of huts from
@Starbird_Resources
’s now infamous orc tiles (and there’s still time, folks). These huts, dare I say, feature a level of bloodlessness that may make them suitable to the decor of many other villages as well!
WaywardMartian
Our armor clad dwarves are starting to get the bottom ready for battle.
@WaywardMartian
provides two options, one more of a chainmail skirt and one more of a pant! Styling on the battlefield!
Guardinthena
If by any chance you thought there was too much angel representation
@Guardinthena
has a nice little set of imp resources for you! Two different wing colors have been created in a complete set of battlers, face graphics, and sprites!
Thank you, all~

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
Day #11
​
You know the drill! Leave your likes, comments, and love in our contributor’s threads by opening the links to reveal your gifts for the day!
Avery
Did you guys know
@Avery
has been working throughout the year to fill up the “What the MZ RTP is Missing” excel sheet? SO, by the way. If you haven’t been by there recently,
go!
Today she completed another cell! The SF_Willowthewisp Bust, Face, and Emoset were on the menu. This little guy is kinda cute! I don’t think they have to be a foe at all!
Slimmmeiske2
One of those things that make you go, “huh, now that I think about it.”
@slimmmeiske2
has pondered a true philosophical question, “what if fairies don’t have to fly 24/7? These fairies sprites come with the option to draw their wings in. Fairies have perfectly good legs if those wings get tired!
GalacticGod
@GalacticGod
has converted another one of Thalzon’s battlers into SV form once again. We’ve gone with Slug_07a, a great pick up as many biomes can contain the critter. I almost said, little critter…but I suppose it could be an egregiously large slug!
Starbird_Resources
One must ponder how the orcs have not already made a serious claim to true domination of the lands. If they have captured dragons, or even possibly trained them since birth, to do their bidding—it’s so over!
@Starbird_Resources
has also revealed more war drums and gongs, so at least we’re gonna go with a tune.
WaywardMartian
@WaywardMartian
still has the flawless one, two punch down as leg armor has been revealed for the male dwarf bases as well! Matching colors, textiles, and all the finery of their co-ed battlers, ready to go!
Guardinthena
I said earlier in the calendar I was a sucker for window skins. Well, the other thing I’m a sucker for is emote balloons!
@Guardinthena
has made a set with a Norse flair to them. The old and weathered appearance is perfect for games where the standard set might be a bit too crisp and punchy.
Thank you, all~

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
Day #12 and #13
​
You know the drill! Leave your likes, comments, and love in our contributor’s threads by opening the links to reveal your gifts for the day!
The font keeps changing from Arial to Courier New. I’m leaving it. K. Thanks. Bye.
Avery
Day 12
-
Day 13
We have even more goodies to make full use of
@Avery
’s will-o-wisp buddy. Yes. It’s buddy to me. It’s fire, but still friend shaped. We have some SV Battlers to make sure you can summon or even recruit the elemental. And, sure. I
suppose
it can still be an enemy.
Day #13 features an extension to the exquisite set of ice cave and ice castle tile sets that Avery has made over the years. This extension fills out the B sheet some more but also provides battle backs to make sure the right tone is stuck throughout the entire environment!
Slimmmeiske2
Day 12
-
Day 13
Behind door #12 is some earthy-toned fairies. These more muted greens and cool browns that
@slimmmeiske2
used would not only be perfect for a forest setting, but anything involving the earth element IMO.
Day #13 is absolutely
packed
with down/damaged sprites, not only from this year, but last year’s calendar as well! Since many of these absolutely work as sleeping sprites, even more bedding options have been made to strike the perfect interior design.
GalacticGod
Day 12
-
Day 13
We have another entry checked off for MZ’s SV Battlers.
@GalacticGod
has created an absolutely wonderful battler for MZ_SF_Monster_6. This robot enemy features a lot of small, intricate details. Hats off! It’s the perfect worker robot to lead up to your larger and more equipped combat robots in any Sci-Fi setting.
Day #13 features brass and copper pipe work intended for Steam Punk settings. But, you thinking what I’m thinking? Seems like a perfect tile to accompany places robots may roam!!
Starbird Resources
Day 12
-
Day 13
Day #12 strikes almost a tone of dueling images. The castle towns are beautifully decorated with calming, cool water features and lilies such as that seen in
@Starbird_Resources
‘s tile sets, but as we know, the castle towns are often a spectacle of public executions. This is perfectly illustrated with the guillotine and pyres.
Day #13 takes us back to our favorite orc encampment. At least maybe we understand why so many humans have tried to involve themselves in their affairs. Looks like they’re loaded! Tons of treasure chests to try and get a hold of, but those orcs seem to always be a step ahead. They’re locked with spells! Suppose you’ll need to figure out a way to dispel them!
Hiddenone
Day 13
@hiddenone
has rejoined us to deliver a 12 days of Christmas gift. We have the
most—
ADORABLE.
Pig folk sprites. That’s actually so cute, I could die. Look at those little flappy ears!! Ah!!!
WaywardMartian
Day 12
-
Day 13
Oooooeeee!
@WaywardMartian
has pulled a fast one on us! We have new sprite bases for dwarven children! Anything that helps make child sprites a possibility is a huge + in my book! On day #12 we’ve started out with the bases in the same color ways, but day #13 has already begun the journey of getting them outfitted for the days ahead.
Guardinthena
Day 12
-
Day 13
Celebrate Christmas any way you like! Prefer spooky season? Stay spooky!
@Guardinthena
thinks so too! Day #12 features a ghost lady, dressed all in white. All, but her increasingly dark and bloodied eyes. A full emoset, sprite set, and SV battler are packaged to begin telling her story.
For #13, a wonderful collection of main set pieces. These giant skulls can act as the opening to a special dungeon or cavern. A perfect way to introduce pirate themes, or even forgotten Gods. What is their origin? Something of legend? Something man made?
​
Thank you, all~

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
Day #14 and #15
​
You know the drill! Leave your likes, comments, and love in our contributor’s threads by opening the links to reveal your gifts for the day!
Avery
Day 14
-
Day 15
In the theme of keeping it simple
@Avery
once again completes a large chunk of needed resources. In her words, Kappa needed a bust. He got one! A face and emoset too, of course!
Going right on over to Day #15, some fantastic statues have been crafted. Taking on more of a mage or lordly appearance, several aspects of the elements can placed in his hand. This opens up a
lot
of puzzle design opportunities, so get moving! A variant with overgrowth means you can place these in towns or ruins with absolute ease. Not enough? Oh yeah…a version with demon horns too! Happy mapping!
Slimmmeiske2
Day 14
-
Day 15
Everyone loves tall sprites and
@slimmmeiske2
delivers an oodle of the general color variants and numerous bride color variants in tall form. On other side is also super tiny with some downed sprite animations of the tiny fairies from last year!
Day #15 is a slight game of switcheroo~ where the knight becomes princess, the princess becomes knight, and a new character is born from all these ideas! This release is truly packed with many color and outfit variants to make finding the perfect warrior princess for your game a breeze.
GalacticGod
Day 14
-
Day 15
@GalacticGod
uses Day #14 to continue fleshing out the Wolfman expansion from the 2022 Advent Calendar by creating the white coloration in SV Battler form. I wonder which one is stronger?!
Another Marvel character appears for Day #15. This time Mephisto joins us with a character sprite so he can add your game’s world to his already long resume of cross over appearances.
Starbird_Resources
Day 14
-
Day 15
We take another step into the somewhat mystic and alien offerings from
@Starbird_Resources
with these glowing stone formations and towering fungi. Some snowy conifers sweeten the deal for some added foliage.
Day #15 offers some new expressions of death and dungeons with many skull motifs and grand stonework perfect for a more desert setting.
Hiddenone
Day 14
-
Day 15
@hiddenone
decided the adorable pig folk needed an equally adorable friend in the village (of excruciating cuteness) and created another friend-shaped sprite set of fox folk. Though, maybe they have a little rivalry between their village shops?
Day #15 sees us expanding the window skin set provided earlier in the month. This set comes with a beautiful, decorative motif that will impart a regal feeling to your windows. The darker hues easily tap more into the mysterious.
WaywardMartian
Day 14
-
Day 15
The dwarven children now have a few sets of pants and shoes at the ready, which means they’re able to make their game debut! These will also fit other child bases, so perhaps the dwarven children have made friends outside their villages and gifted them their customary clothing?
On Day #15
@WaywardMartian
has provided another hair expansion that will fit any of the bases. The perfect way to vary up a cast of characters!
Guardinthena
Day 14
-
Day 15
@Guardinthena
uses day #14 and #15 to hit us with a one, two punch. Introducing a diver character clad in the classic rendition of diver’s gear, we start out with the character sprites and downed position. However, we don’t have to wait long at all for the full bust, face, and emoset to make this a fully fledged character waiting for your story to begin.
Thank you, all~

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
Day #16 and #17
​
You know the drill! Leave your likes, comments, and love in our contributor’s threads by opening the links to reveal your gifts for the day!
Avery
Day 16
-
Day 17
We have a fine selection of generator parts for face and sprite provided by
@Avery
This set is for the ladies and features a pigtail hair style and a half up, half down hair styles. The eyes have a softness to them that captures a real brightness. Pop them in the generator and make the perfect character with them!
OK…huge lore drop. Like many great heroes, Sir Oinkers started life in a cozy, rural town. You can follow his early days with these busts and sprites from his younger days.
Or, if you’re boring, it can just be a normal pig.
Avery also has some farm tools at the ready to demonstrate the simple but never ending busy work of rural life.
Slimmmeiske2
Day 16
-
Day 17
And, now the fellas! We’re playing the same game of dress up and having the prince turn warrior knight and the knight turn prince, once again expanding the options of characters you could have play these rolls. And, hey, the prince in a royal dress is a perfect addition too~
Day #17 sees us celebrating
@slimmmeiske2
‘s birthday with some of her favorite things, RPG Maker XP. The sprites for Nobel 1, 2, 4, and 5 have been given an MZ coat of paint so they can continue to journey alongside you!
GalacticGod
Day 16
-
Day 17
We have another drop of weapons and weapon icons from
@GalacticGod
‘s calendar. We have an assortment of RPG classics like rods and axes, but there’s another creative burst with a vine whip that would be a perfect accessory for anyone with a command of the natural wild.
Day #17 features an incredibly cool conversion of another Thalzon battler. The battler depicts a form with a crescent moon as a head and is draped in flowing, tattered cloaks. The idea of Nocnista originates from folklore to inflict and torment children with nightmares.
Starbird_Resources
Day 16
-
Day 17
We’re taking a step into the ornate.
@Starbird_Resources
‘s set today has a selection of wrought iron fences, with an option adorned with vines. There is even more iron work depicting the royal symbol at the gate entrances. These can be further detailed with optional drapery in the country’s colors~ Even more, there is an abundance of incredibly detailed stone work to leave you in awe of this sovereign’s architecture and design budget.
Day #17 provides a variety of outer brick wall colors that are perfect for an “in progress” state of building or a “ruinous” state of building depending on your perceptions
and
needs for these tiles.
Hiddenone
Day 16
-
Day 17
Our adorable friends are back in
@hiddenone
‘s calendar. These two days feature our pig folk and fox folk again, but some of them are dressed in snappy little vests looking for honest, good work. Some of them? They’re dressed in little bandanas! Which is
obviously
the universal symbol of trouble! Do some of our pig folk and fox folk have…beef? Or, are they just living life a little tough and willing to turn to tricks?
WaywardMartian
Day 16
-
Day 17
We’re still in a hairy situation over on
@WaywardMartian
‘s calendar, but the people are speaking and love it! We have double English braids for the lady dwarves and a half-up, half-down for the gents. With a little elbow grease, the male hairstyle can fit other bases with ease. We also have another selection of fridge/bangs to frame each hair style perfectly, and these will work with any of the bases.
Guardinthena
Day 16
-
Day 17
The next two doors in
@Guardinthena
’s calendar work absolutely perfectly together. The head gear and clothing from the dancer expansion have been broken out into generator parts. This opens a lot of possibilities!
The dancer could be an entire class in your game with this set. The skeleton dancer could have been one of a select group that survive and are trying to avenge her death. You can now create those characters with ease! The choices are endless, and they’re yours.
Thank you, all~

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
Day #18
​
You know the drill! Leave your likes, comments, and love in our contributor’s threads by opening the links to reveal your gifts for the day!
Avery
The ice castle has its very own world map tile thanks to
@Avery
‘s world map extension. This landmark can now make its stately presence known at all levels of mapping. The set also includes many other biomes from grassland to volcanic regions and provides many rocky feature, so no flat maps!
Slimmmeiske2
I think it’s funny that
@slimmmeiske2
calls this a “smaller release” when the screen scrolls rather mightily before getting to the end. This release features the noble glow up from her b-day post and provides numerous additional recolors to make court diverse and lively.
GalacticGod
We had another birthday! Day #18 was
@GalacticGod
‘s birthday and we celebrated with filling in another SV Battler for the MZ RTP. MZ_SF_Monster_4 is the “mad clown” character, and honestly, a creepy clown for a birthday is definitely a mood. This clown is 100% ready for his SV Battle debut~
Starbird_Resources
We have even more delightful exterior decor options from
@Starbird_Resources
on Day #18. This lovely tile set features many housing materials that are further adorned with some exterior wooden cladding to create an adorable, quaint town setting.
Hiddenone
Another absolutely grand drop of window skin options.
@hiddenone
has gone for another set that has a bit more of an industrial look to it. The color options are reminiscent of weathered metals and the repeating motifs leave something that is still rather mysterious, but I suppose that’s up to you, isn’t it?
WaywardMartian
Today’s hair offering is a fantastic set of fancy, twirl-y mustaches (how much product would that take?!)
@WaywardMartian
also makes the fantastic suggestion to stack and layer mustaches until they turn into epic beards.
Guardinthena
For Day #18 we make a call back to the beginning! Remember when
@Guardinthena
started us out with female android sprites? Well now there is a male counterpart! This could be perfect either as a solo assistant or as a great way to add a flair of contrasting android personalities.
Thank you, all~

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
Day #19
​
You know the drill! Leave your likes, comments, and love in our contributor’s threads by opening the links to reveal your gifts for the day!
Avery
An RPG classic joins the collection of SV Battlers. Did you think grabbing the loot would be
that
simple? It never can be!
@Avery
provides a fantastic SV Battler of the chest mimic so it can put up a full fight before the hero can get any treasure. As a delightful bonus, truly the most appetizing pastry icons one can imagine are also gifted today!
Slimmmeiske2
As the darkest day of the year draws near (well…in the northern hemisphere) I can kind of vibe with
@slimmmeiske2
’s darkness fairy sprites. Hood drawn, this fairy really does appear to be up to even more tricks and mischief than their typical counterpart.
GalacticGod
Today we have a couple fresh iterations of Reid as envisioned by
@GalacticGod
Each comes with a sprite and the SV Battler. Which Reid tells your story the best? We have a more stylized face with gentle eyes and a more detailed nose. The other is Reid as the Wolfman himself! Perfect for a transformation mechanic? You decide~
Starbird_Resources
Roofs, roofs, roofs! Pitched Roofs! Everyone loves pitched roofs! Every house, every color, every where. Height, dimension, variety. Oh, they really make a village pop.
@Starbird_Resources
provides a brilliant and colorful set of pitched roofs that perfectly polish off the exterior building tiles from the other day.
Hiddenone
Our little piggy pals are about a lot more than work and shop keeping.
@hiddenone
has the pig folk wearing their best threads now. Do the pig folk have a complex social hierarchy at hand, or is there an incredible celebration to be had?
WaywardMartian
Back into the realm of clothing today,
@WaywardMartian
has provided another set of tops for the female dwarves so each sprite can strike the balance of variety and personality needed for a dynamic group of individuals.
Guardinthena
Oh! What do we have here? A counterpart to the white ghost lady exists in
@Guardinthena
’s brand new red ghost lady. With a sprite, face set, and battler you can tell a unique story of her own, or perhaps as a pair with the white ghost lady. The imagery of red and white roses comes to come for me in particular. Sounds like the stage for a ghost story to me!
​
Thank you, all~

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
Day #20 and #21
​
You know the drill! Leave your likes, comments, and love in our contributor’s threads by opening the links to reveal your gifts for the day!
Avery
Day 20
-
Day 21
There are many incredible selections in this stretch of
@Avery
’s calendar! Career sprites make any game world look and feel more real. For modern worlds, construction workers will bring the presence of never-ending road closures and a chef sprite will serve perfect food needed to replenish your heroes on their journey. If you need something a little more morbid, an autopsy sprite is available for any morticians and pair perfectly with
@Candacis
‘s
morgue tiles
(special shoutout~)
As if that wasn’t already cool enough, the full emoset and bust set for SF Actor 2_3 is now complete and checked off for MZ.
Day #21 reminds us that it’s never too early to start thinking about Halloween. This icon set has Halloween essentials and the phases of the moon. Anyone using a calendar system can get plenty of non-witchy mileage from these moon phases as well! The day is finished off with a selection of statues bridging demonic and angelic.
Slimmmeskie2
Day 20
-
Day 21
Hilda of RPG Maker XP legacy is brought into the age of MZ by
@slimmmeiske2
on Day #20. A couple variants have been created to honor special renditions of the classic character over the years, as well a green witch variant for all those traditional wicked witches.
Day #21 takes inspiration from the generator to make child versions of the People4-1, 3, and 4 sheets. Perfect for either a massively strong family resemblance or age-reversal shenanigans. SV Battlers are also completed to make for a pretty stacked release on this concept.
Galactic God
Day 20
-
Day 21
@GalacticGod
has transformed another MZ character into a form fit for battle. MZ_People3_5 does have an air of aristocracy to him with his long purple jacket and white gloves, likely silk, of course. This makes me view him as a high ranking official who is either on the right hand side of the antagonist or maybe he even defects to help you?!
Day #21 returns to recreations of famous characters. Up this time is Mega Man. Today we have sprites of the blue bomber in a set of complimentary colors that are not~ blue!
Starbird_Resources
Day 20
-
Day 21
Day #20 gives us another infusion of gnarled, twisting trees. This could assist in creating the perfect ambiance and foreshadowing as the party works through an unsettling and haunted woods…perhaps to that orc settlement?
We then make a trip back to the sets for those town buildings on Day #21. The perfect compliment to adorned woodworking is naturally windows with matching trims and shutters~ These come in colors that match the roofs, though maybe you can mix and match for maximum personality and expression of color? These windows also come in a few states of repair. Even the most lovely homes have a project that has been put off too long! Or, you know…the village could be under attack!
Hiddenone
Day 20
-
Day 21
Our fox folk step into the roll of traveling merchants in
@hiddenone
‘s calendar. Perhaps they sell special wares you can only obtain from them? Or, perhaps they have a huge stake in the global market?! There are also finely dressed fox folk, probably in need of a fantastic party or ball. Perhaps you’ll help them fetch the decorations and food?
It’s a window skin day on Day #21! If the last set had a few too many right angles for you, you’re in luck! Today’s assortment has a swirling pattern that makes me think of magic. The green in particular makes me think of the wind element, though perhaps the other colors speak to other arcane themes and magics.
Wayward Martian
Day 20
-
Day 21
Never a step behind,
@WaywardMartian
has come out with the additional set of tops for the male dwarves featured throughout the calendar. Think of all the ways you can mix and match for a personalized population. The beauty of these sets is the ease in which you can tweak them.
Because, on that note, the female dwarves have completed their fashion statements with another set of skirts and trousers. Don’t hesitate to experiment! Playing with these large generator sets is always a joy!
Guardinthena
Day 20
-
Day 21
To fill the place of an earth elemental
@Guardinthena
has made Day #20 a day of dryads, one of my favorite folklore entities, personally~ The set features a gorgeous assortment of colors spanning the different seasons and the sprite work perfectly captures the motifs of leaves and bark in their features. Absolutely excellent work in this set!
Day #21 expands on a handful of the previous days with additions and expansions. We have an emoset for the male android to fully mirror the female release now. A cherry blossom variant of the dryad is destined to be a crowd favorite, I predict! And, finally, some color variations of the hot springs will allow options for what these bodies of liquids actually contain within them!
Thank you, all~

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
Day #22 and #23
​
You know the drill! Leave your likes, comments, and love in our contributor’s threads by opening the links to reveal your gifts for the day!
Avery
Day 22
-
Day 23
For Day #22,
@Avery
checks off another set of needed default expansions with the goblin character. With the face set, bust set, and SV Battler for the character now complete, the goblin can play larger and more vital rolls to your game creations.
Day #23 is for the horse girls out there! A whole icon sheet for horses and horse-adjacent creatures. This set provides a robust selection of coat colors and patterns to fulfill whatever diverse horse-related mechanics your game may contain.
Slimmmeiske2
Day 22
-
Day 23
Day #22 nudges us back over to
@slimmmeiske2
’s sci-fi side of the calendar. We have two window skin options with a binary motif and color gradients reminiscent of a glowing screen. A few tiles are also provided to serve as the in-game consoles and computers these window skins take inspiration from.
Day #23 brings us a groom sprite to be the perfect companion for the bride sprites featured throughout advent. Another suggestion of child rulers has also been gifted to us! A crowned boy and girl adorned in all the royal finery is a great addition. Child rulers are actually a rather real thing throughout history. Great suggestion!
GalacticGod
Day 22
-
Day 23
Day #22 fleshes out the Mega Man sprites
@GalacticGod
gifted yesterday with a complimentary set of SV Battlers in the same selection of colors. This is perfect to take him off the sidelines and right into the battle!
For day #23, we have an absolutely fantastic set of gargoyle sprites. Not only is there a full character sprite for after the awakening, but there is a gargoyle awakening upon its pedestal to depict the nature of these incredible statues.
Starbird_Resources
Day 22
-
Day 23
Day #22 is an exciting infusion of tiles. There are so many goodies that it’s almost rather difficult to pick favorites! There are chests, broken mirrors, potted plants, flooring, furniture, more! You really have to go see for yourself!
Day #23 gifts us even more tiles, but this time it’s a wide selection of auto tiles. These auto tiles range from outdoor to indoors and feature many textures and patterns to pick from. Another fantastic find!
Hiddenone
Day 22
-
Day 23
Day #22 and #23 actually pair rather perfectly together! The final batches of pig folk and fox folk from
@hiddenone
’s 12 Days of Christmas clothe our new animal pals in robes.
The villages could possibly have magic users, clergy, or even bandits disguising themselves as such! The story options are rich and endless, but you’ll have to craft them to find out!
WaywardMartian
Day 22
-
Day 23
The dwarves are still coming along perfectly in
@WaywardMartian
‘s calendar. In the same fashion as the ladies, the gents have also finished off their wardrobes with another set of skirts and trousers. Dress to impress~
Day #23 is offering up another set of those characteristic beards the dwarves love to sport oh-so much. Per usual, these will fit other bases as well!
Guardinthena
Day 22
-
Day 23
The MV Dancer is rounded out with another set of generator pieces from
@Guardinthena
This outfit can now be donned by any SV sprite of your choosing making an entire dancer class easy peasy.
Day #23 brings back the
invisible stalker!
Whatever the origin of their invisibility is, that will be your own tale to tell. But, with this SV Battler of the legendary stalker, they will not go down without a fight!
Thank you, all~

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
Merry Christmas
​
Avery
We celebrate Christmas with
@Avery
’s gorgeous church tile set. This is an expansive collection of walls, floors, rugs
,
and decor. There is no shortage of tables, shelves, lighting, and the pinnacle of stained glass tiles
that also include the scattered projections from the sunlight outside.
Slimmmeiske2
We celebrate Christmas with
@slimmmeiske2
’s gilded counterpart of the dark fairy, a light fairy~ This fairy features white hair and golden wings, reminiscent of dancing candle flames. We even get a sweetened deal with a “fairy-i-fication” of the goddess sprite!
GalacticGod
We celebrate Christmas with
@GalacticGod
’s SV Battler of MZ’s default King. A true leader leads by example, so a King that finally gets off his rump and protects his own kingdom is a welcome addition to the battler roster!
Starbird_Resources
We celebrate Christmas with
@Starbird_Resources
tile set extending even more offerings for the legendary orc set with additional lookouts and landings. There is also an incredible statue of a praying angel. This statue is seriously giving “main visual element” vibes.
Hiddenone
We celebrate Christmas with another beautiful set of
@hiddenone
‘s window skins. This one features a cog/gear motif that is essential for the steam punk fans out there. We have the classic copper colors usually associated with the technology, but there are plenty of color variants for any fans of the cool-toned metals. On Christmas morning, we also had some sneaky recolors for the other sets that were snuck right in~
WaywardMartian
We celebrate Christmas with another
@WaywardMartian
generator piece. This one holds a lot of utility! It’s a set of dwarf ears that can be overlayed on any hairstyle if a character fancies an out of the face look~
Thank you, all~

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
Time for the administrative double post.
Cough
, mod abuse!
This thread has been moved to General Resources due to being
complete!!
Be mindful that many of these resources
do
use varied pieces from specific engines,
so double check the terms and conditions!
Christmas may be over, but every day can be used to spread cheer. Our contributors, and countless other creators, donate their incredible skills and valuable time all year round. Any day is a good day to say “thank you” and “well done.”
A special thank you to
@Avery
@slimmmeiske2
@GalacticGod
@Starbird_Resources
@hiddenone
@WaywardMartian
and
@Guardinthena
These advent calendars are a marathon feat that blows me away every year. Every year I grow a little more inspired.
This was linked in post #1, but I do want to make sure anyone who missed
2023
can still quickly grab it after this 2024 sticky takes its place.
Have a blessed and healthy Happy Holiday~
